comment: Inputs release builds take from other repositories, each pinned to a tag checked against its revision (scripts/pinned-checkout.sh). libs-back has its own lock file, with its patches (packaging/linux/libs-back). Local builds can still point at their own trees with ADWAITA_THEME and LIBS_BACK_BUNDLE. The same pins as LinDirStat's AppImage.

gnustep-packager.comment: The merge of #57 (the reusable workflow checks out its own commit). No tag yet: move to v0.1.1 when it is cut.

appimagetool.comment: gnustep-packager's default is appimagetool's moving continuous build; 0.1.3 was made with build 295 (8c8c91f). Release 1.9.1 is build 296 from the same commit. scripts/fetch-appimagetool.sh installs it where the packager looks, and the packager takes the AppImage runtime from it.

powershell.comment: gnustep-packager runs on PowerShell; the release workflow's Debian container installs this (scripts/ci-release-linux.sh). The version used locally.
